newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Credit Agricole H1 pre-tax up 21.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Credit Agricole H1 pre-tax up 21.6 pct.

text.p: Belgian bank Groupe Credit Agricole/Groep Landbouwkrediet said on Tuesday current pre-tax profit rose by 21.6 percent to 594 million Belgian francs in the six months to June 30 compared with the first half of 1995.

The margin on interest business grew clearly, while general costs were practically stable. Write-offs, depreciations and provisions were increased, partly due to a considerable addition to the bank's internal health fund. Taxes more than doubled.
The small agricultural bank said in a statement it expected full-year 1996 profit to at least match that of 1995.
Groupe Credit Agricole CNCAp.PA /Groep Landbouwkrediet is owned by Bacob Bank, a top seven Belgian bank, insurer Swiss Life RNTZp.S and the Belgian state.
